title: artifact_version body
description: A changed version of the artifact, sent back by the offer's receiver when the share gives edit (spec/protocol.md section 5.22), sealed to the sender alone. The sender checks it like anything received, and nothing in it acts as its owner's. Comes with the feature artifacts.

blobs.description: The blob's parts, in order, when the ciphertext is over 64 MiB: blob is then the whole, and its id the first part's.
